+PHYSICAL AUTHENTICATION + EPCIS

Authentication beyond the packaging.

When the packaging is gone, how do your partners assess whether the device is genuine?

iTRACE brings marking and authentication to the physical item. Trust.med connects that evidence with EPCIS data, helping partners review returns, investigate questioned devices, and assess items entering service.
